comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body:
I made 999 of this and boy do I feel stupid throwing all of this out now ..facepalm.. This thing is worth about 10-30k each and I will be making more

This is SUPPOSED to be used in conjunction with stomach medicine and Course Meals at taverns to rapidly increase your Aide Sailing Day bonus 2-3 days each time. Aides are a major pain in the bum to level but with aide sailing day bonus it buffs this quite a bit my aide gets 500 exp a day! so 1 buff is equal to 1500 xp in just 3 days of sailing WIN!!!

Which is perfect for boosting aides to go to Royal navy and transfer their skill to any other aide

You can get many bonuses for course meal combinations but the best one by far is the one that increases your aide daily sailing bonus by 2-3days. You can only get this effect 1 time a port hop if you dont get it pop a sober and a stomach med and try again once you get it port hop try again.

A few combinations for this Course Meal Effect are

Cueta
Liquer, Tortilla, bacalahu croqutte, Chicken Paella, milk

London
Milk, Rye Knackerbrot x3, Milk

Genoa
Fruit wine,Raw ham, Seafood Pizza ,Bouillabaisse, Milk

Good luck Raising your Aides' Levels Sell this stuff in those taverns make some cash! lol

comments.author: Hawthorne
comments.body:
In St. Petersburg, the following combo is effective:
Mors + Shchi x3 + Mors

In most places, buying the cheapest non-alcoholic drink, three of the cheapest courses, and the cheapest non-alcoholic drink to end will potentially get you the special bonus. This does not seem to be the case with East Asian food, however.
